segments.title: 第159章 汗流浹背了
segments.content:
Chapter 159: Breaking Out in a Cold Sweat

Qian Zhou had no idea how he managed to finish his meal.

Even though he had prepared himself to meet Yuan Wanqing in person on the high-speed train ride from Changning City.

But he never imagined he would meet a real-life celebrity this way.

Throughout the entire meal, he was too embarrassed to look up. Even though he, as the editor, was supposed to lead the conversation, he couldn't bring himself to say anything.

Yuan Wanqing's presence was simply too powerful.

Although she was wearing loungewear and no makeup, and her whole demeanor seemed very gentle.

But the moment he remembered she was a huge star, Qian Zhou was at a loss for words.

He was just a corporate drone who had been working for less than half a year.

In contrast, Li Luo, beside him, was calm and composed. While eating slowly and deliberately, he was able to chat casually with Yuan Wanqing.

He talked about some of the small, everyday things at school, sharing some of Yan Zhusheng's school life.

By comparison, Li Luo was the one who had seen the world.

But when Yuan Wanqing asked, "So, something like what Li Luo is writing now, what level would that be on your platform?"

At this moment, Li Luo suddenly went silent.

Qian Zhou blinked blankly before realizing the question was for him.

He quickly replied, "Reigniting is already considered very impressive."

"His book is in the urban genre, and on our website's ranking charts, he's already in third place."

"In other words, just for this month, he is one of the top three most popular authors among all readers of the urban genre on the entire website."

Now that the conversation had turned to his area of expertise, Qian Zhou finally started speaking much more fluently.

In front of Yuan Wanqing, he didn't hold back his words, praising Li Luo to the skies.

"So this interview will be helpful for him, right?" Yuan Wanqing pressed.

She had accepted the invitation for this exclusive interview with Wenyue Group to repay Li Luo's favor.

If it wasn't of much help to Li Luo himself, then there wouldn't be much point.

"It will definitely be helpful." Qian Zhou nodded repeatedly. "After all, you have a huge following right now. If you can just help promote his book once, his numbers will probably skyrocket."

"What do you think, Li Luo?" Yuan Wanqing turned to Li Luo.

After all, she had heard similar things from the people at Wenyue Group, but this was something Li Luo himself had to be clear on.

"First, thank you for your support, Auntie Yuan." Li Luo forced a smile. "This will definitely be a great help to me. After all, the more people read, the more royalties I get."

But if he had a choice, Li Luo would rather Yuan Wanqing didn't know he was writing this stuff.

But what's done is done, so Li Luo could only think about it.

Since things had already come to this, he might as well take as much benefit as he could.

After all, it was a kind gesture from Auntie Yuan, so he should just accept it.

"I've never read anything like this before. It feels quite novel." Yuan Wanqing looked at Li Luo, then at Qian Zhou, and asked curiously, "Something like this, um... transmigration? Is that how you say it?"

"Transmigrating to another world, and then becoming a big star step by step by plagiarizing all sorts of works from reality."

"The idea is certainly fresh. Do a lot of people like to read this?"

Qian Zhou glanced at Li Luo. Seeing that he wasn't speaking, he nodded and said, "In our web novel community, this is called the entertainment genre, which is related to the entertainment industry."

"After all, real-life celebrities are very glamorous. At least on the surface, they make money easily, can appear in public, are adored by many, and gain a lot of fans."

"So, more or less, everyone has a bit of a celebrity dream. If they can't achieve it in real life, they can at least fantasize about it in a novel."

Yuan Wanqing nodded in understanding, then casually asked one more question, "So, the male protagonist liking several girls is also something a lot of people like to read, right?"

As soon as she said this.

Li Luo instantly broke out in a cold sweat.

Qian Zhou, at the side, also opened his mouth, feeling a bit embarrassed, and coughed several times. "This, well... love between men and women is a natural human feeling. Ancient emperors had three palaces and six courtyards, so many male readers have the fantasy of having a harem and being surrounded by women."

"So, for an author to cater a little to the audience's preferences to write content that readers enjoy is also understandable."

"After all, in real life, everyone may encounter several memorable girls in their lifetime."

"But in the end, they might only be able to choose one of them, or even have no right to choose at all."

"And web novels, being a form of fantasy literature, are created to satisfy some of the fantasies that readers can't achieve in reality."

"So... um... the situation you described does exist, but the male protagonist's actions and thoughts in the book aren't necessarily the same as the author's."

Qian Zhou explained at length, sweating bullets, and Li Luo couldn't help but want to give him a thumbs-up.

Beside them, Yan Zhusheng looked at Qian Zhou, then at Li Luo, and used her chopsticks to place a piece of meat in Li Luo's bowl.

"That's right," Li Luo nodded, "It was originally just a small segment to deal with a plot sideline. Inspiration struck while I was writing, so I wrote a song along with it."

"Then do you plan to write your other songs into the book?" Yuan Wanqing asked again.

"He has other songs?!" Before Li Luo could respond, Qian Zhou's mouth had already dropped open in surprise. "You can actually write songs?"

Qian Zhou had originally thought that "Annual Rings" was just a sudden flash of inspiration for Li Luo.

But who would have thought that besides writing novels, this kid could also consistently create songs?

"I'll probably... consider writing them in," Li Luo said ambiguously. "Is Auntie Yuan worried that the two songs I sold you before will be written into the book before they're released?"

"I'm not worried about that," Yuan Wanqing smiled, then said, "I was just thinking that if this promotion works well, this could be a stable promotional point."

"I hadn't been back in the country for a long time, and I didn't pay much attention to what was happening online after I returned."

"But after this incident with 'Annual Rings' blowing up, I think I understand a few things."

"They all say 'Immortal Fate of the Jade Pool' is a terrible film, so why is the online discussion so heated, and how could it also make 'Annual Rings' so popular?"

"If necessary, an author who is also an excellent pop-song composer and can write new songs into his book."

"I think that's a very interesting promotional method."

Yuan Wanqing's words gave Li Luo some new ideas, and his mind instantly started racing.

"Auntie Yuan." A spark of inspiration flashed through Li Luo's mind, and he couldn't help but look at Yuan Wanqing with a burning gaze. "I have a half-baked idea, I wonder if you'd be interested?"

"Oh?" Yuan Wanqing raised an eyebrow. "Let's hear it."

"Would you mind releasing an album single in my novel?"

(End of this chapter)
